title: Split status rendering out of display.rs into a submodule
summary: Reduce crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs below 1500 production lines (target ~1100) by moving the status-rendering group (plan_suffix, sections, snapshot_status, status, code_health_section, introspection, roughly lines 992–1473) into crates/athena-cli/src/display/status_view.rs, re-exported so callers and tests are unchanged. Audience: the code-health gate and maintainers; no behavior change.

defaults_applied.how: tests run to show unchanged behavior
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs item layout (pure string-rendering functions, tests module from line ~1943) and listed crates/athena-cli/src/; display.rs is a plain module file so a sibling directory display/ can hold a submodule without renaming.
Moving the status group (lines ~992–1473) drops about 480 lines; the split is by responsibility (status view rendering vs. other report rendering).
Shared helpers (pct, usd, duration, etc.) stay in display.rs and are used by the submodule via super::; visibility adjusted to pub(super) as needed.
Longest function status (197 lines) is under the 200 limit and is left alone.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines (test module excluded), and the moved functions live in a new submodule file under crates/athena-cli/src/display/.
Public functions of display (status, snapshot_status, etc.) keep their paths and signatures via `pub use`/`use` re-exports; no caller outside display changes; function bodies are moved verbatim.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`: all existing display tests pass unchanged.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`: both clean.
No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, Cargo configs) are changed; no test is deleted or weakened.

out_of_scope: Splitting other files or raising limits
